description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Batch API of the Apache Fineract project, specifically testing various batch operations such as client creation, loan application, approval, disbursal, repayment, charge management, and transaction adjustments. It uses JUnit, RestAssured, and custom helper classes to perform coordinated API requests verifying correct behavior under multiple scenarios.

classes.name: BatchApiTest
classes.description: Integration test class for testing batch API operations in Apache Fineract, covering a wide range of batch workflows such as client creation, loan processing, charge management, and transaction adjustments.
